I will buy one bag of urea and two bags of NPK 20-10-10 for this 1.71 hectare plot, which the agro-dealer says is the right amount — that works out to about 25 kg of nitrogen for each hectare. I will also spread cattle manure before planting because I have animals and it helps the soil. I am using my own saved seed from last year; improved seed costs too much and my grain sprouts fine. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate — we have no water source here and sorghum does not need it if the rains come. My family will put in about fifty labor days on this plot, and I will hire twenty days from the young men in the village when the weeds are thick and at harvest time.
